text:
Alice M: quick thread for the guest-panel dry run tomorrow. goal = 30m panel + 15m live Q&A. guests: Acme_CTO + internal lead. please confirm slots & green room plan.

Ben - Producer: confirmed. green room 20m before show. we'll run a 15m mic check + 10m panel flow. ask guests to join green room 25m early.

Acme_CTO: thanks — I can join green room at T-25. can you send a slide template? i'll have 2 slides (problem, outcome).

Sam G: slide template in drive: https://drive.google.com/example-acme-panel. keep slides to 2 max. Also please do not include any PII or logs.

Priya R: panel questions (draft): 1) What were the top 2 bottlenecks before Redwood? 2) How did latency/cost change after rollout? 3) What tradeoffs did you accept? Short and concrete.

Ben - Producer: run-of-show (tight):
```
- 00:00-02:00 Host intro + goals
- 02:00-15:00 Panel discussion (moderated) — 3 q blocks
- 15:00-25:00 Live demos (2 x 5m quick clips) or fallback video
- 25:00-30:00 Audience Q&A
- 30:00-45:00 Deep-dive office-hours (optional RSVP)
```

Alice M: for demo slots, we have two 5m clips: 1) routing/fallback 2) cost dashboard. Priya can narrate. if live demos fail we play prerecorded 5m clips.

Acme_CTO: okay with prerecorded clip for the customer snippet. i'll send a 90s video and a 1-paragraph case quote.

Sam G: tech checklist: ensure guest's network has stable upstream (suggest wired), minimize VPN, grant them presenter role in the webinar tool. ops-bot, please confirm presenter permissions.

ops-bot: Check: presenter permissions verified for Acme_CTO. Reminder: enable "mute on entry" for attendees.

Priya R: moderation plan: I'll moderate. 2 backup questions in case audience is quiet. also will run poll at 14:30: "Which area matters most to you? (cost/latency/reliability/integration)" to drive follow-ups.

Ben - Producer: can everyone confirm the pre-record delivery time? we need assets 48h before. Acme_CTO: can you deliver by 2025-10-01 12:00 UTC?

Acme_CTO: yes — I'll upload to the shared drive by then.

Alice M: RSVP gating: office-hours limited to 40 seats. we'll collect cloud & role on signup to route leads. Jenna (marketing ops) will add a hidden field for "interested in pilot".

Sam G: rehearsal schedule: full dress 48h out, panel-only run 24h out. Ben please add calendar invites. calendar-bot: reminder for full dress?

calendar-bot: Events created: "Guest Panel Full Dress" on 2025-10-03 16:00 UTC and "Panel Tech Check" on 2025-10-04 16:30 UTC.

Ben - Producer: final ask: please react with ✅ to confirm your role (presenter, moderator, producer) in this thread. we'll lock slides 24h before.

Alice M: thanks team — keeping this thread for confirmations only. excited for a tight, engineer-friendly panel. :sparkles:
